
This is my cool penguin scatterplot

```{r, fig.cap = "My cool penguin scatterplot"}
ggplot(penguins, aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = bill_depth_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") + 
  labs(x = "Bill length (mm)", y = "Bill depth (mm)",
       color = "")
```
